name: task-message-bus
description: Hook-driven message bus for proactive cross-task messaging between independent Antigravity sessions, with automatic registration, point-to-point/channel/broadcast delivery, and active CLI/App wake-up.

查看最近跨任务消息的投递历史与唤醒状态
